metric_definition: macro IoU over classes with nonzero union; report classes absent from GT and union. Unseen val pixels ignored. No hIoU.
purpose: User-authorized expanded single-seed DLRSD seen-only frozen-feature training; no sealed test and no cross-dataset claim
authorization: User: v1也是吗，在算力充足的情况下可以直接跑训练看看

hypotheses.semantic: C-B and E-D quantify local multi-description selection; no expected class-specific benefit preregistered
hypotheses.spatial: D-B and E-C quantify evidence-conditioned propagation; inspect per-class precision/recall for errors and seen degradation
hypotheses.interaction: E-C-D+B in percentage-point mIoU; single-seed descriptive interaction, no significance claim

engineering.gate: finite decreasing fixed-four-image loss; exact reload and resumed continuation; all four arms

training.optimizer: AdamW default betas; grad norm clip 1.0
training.sampling: uniform with replacement from supervised images
training.checkpoint_selection: fixed final update 4000; no best checkpoint selection

test: sealed; no test images, masks, or reserved manifest read; classes_test.json is taxonomy only
limitations: All encoders frozen; cached deterministic full-image resize224; no online augmentation
Dense CLIP patch projection is an extrapolation of global pretraining alignment
RSIB ViT-B/8 one-level structure; differs from native v2 ResNet adapter
Seen-only original label remap; unseen validation pixels ignored; no hIoU
Single seed, fixed budget; not a convergence or multi-seed claim
Weight pretraining data overlap not independently verified
